exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  f      5  e
  2  a      6  c
  3  d      7  g
  4  h      8  b


⚠ OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI (5, 6, 7-bandlar):

  'ARE you going ...?'  →  'Yes, I AM.'   (5-e)
  'HAVE you ever ...?'  →  'No, I HAVEN'T.'
                                            (6-c)
  'WILL it be ...?'     →  'No, it WON'T.' (7-g)


QOLGAN BESh BAND — SAVOL SO'ZI BO'YIChA:

 1  'WHEN DID you go to Rome?'
    → PAST SIMPLE savoli → o'tgan vaqt
    → 'Two years AGO.' (f)
    (KITOBDA STRELKA ChIZILGAN — NAMUNA)

 2  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
    → MUDDAT so'ralyapti
    → 'SINCE Saturday.' (a)

 3  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the cinema?'
    → ChASTOTA so'ralyapti
    → 'ONCE A WEEK.' (d)

 4  'WHAT IS Jack DOING at the moment?'
    → HARAKAT so'ralyapti (Present Continuous)
    → 'He's SLEEPING.' (h)

 8  'WHEN ARE you LEAVING for your holiday?'
    → KELAJAK vaqti so'ralyapti
    → 'NEXT WEEK.' (b)


⚠ 1 va 8-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK JUFTLIK:

  Ikkalasi ham 'WHEN' bilan boshlanadi,
  lekin ZAMONI boshqa:

   1  'When DID you GO to Rome?'
         PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan)
      → 'Two years AGO.' (o'tgan)

   8  'When ARE you LEAVING for your holiday?'
         PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak reja)
      → 'NEXT WEEK.' (kelajak)

  Ya'ni savolning ZAMONI javobning
  yo'nalishini belgilaydi.


⚠ 2 va 3-BANDLAR — YANA BIR JUFTLIK:

   2  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
      → MUDDAT → 'Since Saturday.'

   3  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the cinema?'
      → ChASTOTA → 'Once a week.'

  'How LONG' ≠ 'How OFTEN'!
     How long  = qancha vaqtdan beri
     How often = qanchalik tez-tez


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'SINCE SATURDAY':
  'How long have you been here?'
  'SINCE Saturday.' (shanbadan beri)

  Javob 'FOR two days' ham bo'lishi mumkin
  edi, lekin ro'yxatda 'since' berilgan.


DIQQAT — 7-BANDDAGI 'WON'T':
  'won't' = will not
  'Will it be cold?' → 'No, it WON'T.'

  DIQQAT: 'willn't' degan shakl YO'Q!


GRAMMAR 67-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday mashq bor edi
  (10-mashq), faqat boshqa savollar bilan.
  Kitob qoidani takrorlagan.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

 1  When did you go to Rome?
    → f  Two years ago.        (NAMUNA)
 2  How long have you been here?
    → a  Since Saturday.
 3  How often do you go to the cinema?
    → d  Once a week.
 4  What is Jack doing at the moment?
    → h  He's sleeping.
 5  Are you going to stay at a hotel?
    → e  Yes, I am.
 6  Have you ever been to India?
    → c  No, I haven't.
 7  Will it be cold in London tomorrow?
    → g  No, it won't.
 8  When are you leaving for your holiday?
    → b  Next week.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Rome      = Rim
  How often ...? = qanchalik tez-tez?
  once a week = haftada bir marta
  India     = Hindiston
  won't     = will not
  to leave for = ... ga jo'namoq

pairs.left: 1  When did you go to Rome?
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN (namuna).

'When DID you GO?' — PAST SIMPLE savoli
→ javob ham O'TGAN vaqt: 'two years AGO'.

'ago' — Past Simple ko'rsatkichi.

pairs.left: 2  How long have you been here?
pairs.leftUz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz?
pairs.whyUz:
'HOW LONG' — MUDDAT so'ralyapti
→ 'SINCE Saturday' (boshlanish nuqtasi).

⚠ 3-BAND BILAN ADASHTIRMANG:
  How LONG  = qancha vaqtdan beri
  How OFTEN = qanchalik tez-tez

pairs.left: 3  How often do you go to the cinema?
pairs.whyUz:
'HOW OFTEN' — CHASTOTA so'ralyapti
→ 'Once a week' (haftada bir marta).

Savol Present Simple da ('do you go') —
odat haqida.

pairs.left: 4  What is Jack doing at the moment?
pairs.whyUz:
'What IS ... DOING?' — HARAKAT so'ralyapti
(Present Continuous).

Javob ham Present Continuous da:
'He'S SLEEPING' (= he IS sleeping).

'at the moment' → Present Continuous.

pairs.left: 5  Are you going to stay at a hotel?
pairs.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi fe'lni TAKRORLAYDI:
'ARE you going to ...?' → 'Yes, I AM.'

DIQQAT: ega o'zgaradi ('you' → 'I').

pairs.left: 6  Have you ever been to India?
pairs.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB: 'HAVE you ...?' → 'No, I
HAVEN'T.'

'ever' — savolda 'hech qachon'.
'been to' — tajriba (borib qaytish).

pairs.left: 7  Will it be cold in London tomorrow?
pairs.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB: 'WILL it ...?' → 'No, it
WON'T.'

'won't' = will not.
DIQQAT: 'willn't' degan shakl YO'Q!

'IT' — ob-havo egasi (Unit 13).

pairs.left: 8  When are you leaving for your holiday?
pairs.whyUz:
'When ARE you LEAVING?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS
(kelajakdagi reja) → javob ham KELAJAK:
'Next week.'

⚠ 1-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING: ikkalasi ham
'When' bilan, lekin zamoni boshqa.

'to leave FOR' = ... ga jo'namoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  a  (NAMUNA)
  2  b
  3  b
  4  a
  5  b
  6  a
  7  a


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  a) 'ARE YOU GOING OUT tonight?'  ✓
    b) 'DO you go out tonight?'      ✗
    'tonight' — kelajakdagi REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    'Do you go out' — odat haqida bo'lardi.
    (KITOBDA ✓ QO'YILGAN)

 2  a) 'Tony READS a book at the moment.' ✗
    b) 'Tony IS READING a book at the
        moment.'                          ✓
    'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

 3  a) 'What HAVE YOU DONE yesterday?'   ✗
    b) 'What DID YOU DO yesterday?'      ✓
    ⚠ 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT, shuning
    uchun PRESENT PERFECT ISHLATILMAYDI.

 4  a) 'Have you ever EATEN snake?'      ✓
    b) 'DID you ever EAT snake?'         ✗
    'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida →
    PRESENT PERFECT.
    ('Did you ever ...?' amerikachada
     uchraydi, lekin britancha kitob
     Present Perfect ni talab qiladi.)

 5  a) 'We've BEEN to Malta LAST SUMMER.' ✗
    b) 'We WENT to Malta last summer.'    ✓
    ⚠ 'LAST SUMMER' — ANIQ VAQT →
    PAST SIMPLE.

 6  a) 'He's FLYING to Athens tonight.'   ✓
    b) 'He HAS FLOWN to Athens tonight.'  ✗
    'tonight' — KELAJAK reja →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    'has flown' — o'tmish, 'tonight' bilan
    mos kelmaydi.

 7  a) 'He WAS BORN on 6th May, 1959.'    ✓
    b) 'He BORN on 6th May, 1959.'        ✗
    ⚠ 'to be born' — DOIM 'be' fe'li bilan:
       'He WAS born.'  ✓
       'He born.'      ✗


⚠ MAShQNING ASOSIY DARSI — UCh XATO TURI:

  A) PRESENT PERFECT + ANIQ VAQT (3, 5)
     'What have you done YESTERDAY?'  ✗
     'We've been to Malta LAST SUMMER.' ✗

     Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi!

  B) NOTO'G'RI ZAMON (1, 2, 6)
     'at the moment' → Continuous
     'tonight' (reja) → Continuous

  C) FE'L TUShIB QOLGAN (7)
     'He born' — 'was' yo'q.


DIQQAT — 7-BAND, 'TO BE BORN':
  'to be born' = tug'ilmoq

  DOIM 'be' fe'li bilan:
     'I WAS BORN in 1990.'
     'She WAS BORN in Tashkent.'
     'When WERE you BORN?'

  O'zbekchada 'tug'ildim' — bir so'z, lekin
  inglizchada IKKI so'z ('was born').

  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan joy.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'FLOWN':
  fly → flew → FLOWN

  'He HAS FLOWN to Athens' — grammatik
  jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin 'tonight' bilan
  mos kelmaydi (kelajak).


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'SNAKE':
  'Have you ever eaten SNAKE?'
  'snake' bu yerda ARTIKLSIZ — chunki
  OVQAT sifatida (sanalmaydigan).

     'a snake' = ilon (hayvon)
     'snake' = ilon go'shti (ovqat)

  Shu kabi: 'chicken' (tovuq go'shti),
  'fish' (baliq go'shti).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to go out   = tashqariga chiqmoq
  a snake     = ilon
  Malta       = Malta
  Athens      = Afina
  to be born  = tug'ilmoq
  to fly      = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)

items.textEn: 1  a) Are you going out tonight?   b) Do you go out tonight?
items.answer: a) Are you going out tonight?
options: a) Are you going out tonight?
b) Do you go out tonight?
items.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ QO'YILGAN (namuna).

'TONIGHT' — kelajakdagi REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Do you go out tonight?' — odat haqida
bo'lardi ('har kecha chiqasizmi?').

items.textEn: 2  a) Tony reads a book at the moment.   b) Tony is reading a book at the moment.
items.answer: b) Tony is reading a book at the moment.
options: b) Tony is reading a book at the moment.
a) Tony reads a book at the moment.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Tony reads' — Present Simple, odat haqida
bo'lardi ('Toni kitob o'qiydi').

items.textEn: 3  a) What have you done yesterday?   b) What did you do yesterday?
items.answer: b) What did you do yesterday?
options: b) What did you do yesterday?
a) What have you done yesterday?
items.whyUz:
⚠ UNIT 15 NING ENG MUHIM QOIDASI:
'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT, shuning uchun
PRESENT PERFECT ISHLATILMAYDI.

'What have you done yesterday?' — XATO!
'What DID you DO yesterday?' ✓

DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl ('do').

items.textEn: 4  a) Have you ever eaten snake?   b) Did you ever eat snake?
items.answer: a) Have you ever eaten snake?
options: a) Have you ever eaten snake?
b) Did you ever eat snake?
items.whyUz:
'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida savol
→ PRESENT PERFECT.

eat → ate → EATEN (V3).

('Did you ever ...?' amerikachada uchraydi,
lekin Enterprise — britancha kitob va
Present Perfect ni talab qiladi.)

DIQQAT: 'snake' ARTIKLSIZ — ovqat sifatida.

items.textEn: 5  a) We've been to Malta last summer.   b) We went to Malta last summer.
items.answer: b) We went to Malta last summer.
options: b) We went to Malta last summer.
a) We've been to Malta last summer.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'LAST SUMMER' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.

'We've been to Malta LAST SUMMER' — XATO!
Present Perfect aniq vaqt bilan
ishlatilmaydi.

3-band bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 6  a) He's flying to Athens tonight.   b) He has flown to Athens tonight.
items.answer: a) He's flying to Athens tonight.
options: a) He's flying to Athens tonight.
b) He has flown to Athens tonight.
items.whyUz:
'TONIGHT' — KELAJAK reja
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'has flown' — o'tmish, 'tonight' (kelajak)
bilan mos kelmaydi.

fly → flew → FLOWN.

items.textEn: 7  a) He was born on 6th May, 1959.   b) He born on 6th May, 1959.
items.answer: a) He was born on 6th May, 1959.
options: a) He was born on 6th May, 1959.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'TO BE BORN' — DOIM 'be' fe'li bilan:
  'He WAS BORN.'  ✓
  'He BORN.'      ✗ (fe'l tushib qolgan)

O'zbekchada 'tug'ildi' — bir so'z, lekin
inglizchada IKKI so'z.

'When WERE you BORN?' — 'Qachon
tug'ilgansiz?'

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to make a pair of sentences, as in the example. Use the words below to help you. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbatma-navbat namunadagidek juft gap tuzing. Quyidagi so'zlardan foydalaning. Har to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'I've NEVER BEEN to London, BUT I've BEEN
   to Paris. I WENT to Paris A YEAR AGO.
   It WAS FANTASTIC.'


QOLIP — UCh GAP:

  1) 'I've NEVER [V3] ..., BUT I've [V3] ...'
     (tajriba: biri yo'q, biri bor)
  2) 'I [V2] ... [ANIQ VAQT].'
     (qachon — Past Simple)
  3) 'It WAS [sifat].'
     (baho — Past Simple)


SO'ZLAR:

  FE'LLAR (doira ichida):
     go, visit, eat, make, play

  OTLAR:
     museum, zoo, London, Chinese food,
     Paris, a cake, football, a pizza,
     Italian food, basketball

  SIFATLAR (baho uchun):
     fantastic, fun, delicious, disgusting,
     horrible, interesting, exciting, boring


QAYSI FE'L QAYSI OT BILAN:

  GO TO      →  London, Paris, the zoo,
                the museum
  VISIT      →  London, Paris, the museum,
                the zoo
  EAT        →  Chinese food, Italian food,
                a cake, a pizza
  MAKE       →  a cake, a pizza
  PLAY       →  football, basketball


BARCHA NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

 1  I've never been to London, but I've been
    to Paris. I went to Paris a year ago.
    It was fantastic.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  I've never visited the museum, but I've
    visited the zoo. I visited the zoo last
    month. It was interesting.

 3  I've never eaten Chinese food, but I've
    eaten Italian food. I ate Italian food
    last week. It was delicious.

 4  I've never made a cake, but I've made a
    pizza. I made a pizza yesterday. It was
    disgusting!

 5  I've never played basketball, but I've
    played football. I played football on
    Sunday. It was fun.


V3 va V2 ShAKLLARI:
  go    →  went    →  BEEN / GONE
  visit →  visited →  VISITED
  eat   →  ate     →  EATEN
  make  →  made    →  MADE
  play  →  played  →  PLAYED

  DIQQAT: birinchi gapda V3, ikkinchi gapda
  V2!
     'I've EATEN Italian food.'  (V3)
     'I ATE it last week.'       (V2)


⚠ ENG MUHIM — 'GO' NING IKKI ShAKLI:
  'I've never BEEN to London.'  ✓
  'I've never GONE to London.'  ✗

  O'zingiz haqingizda DOIM 'been'
  (Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi).


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:
  IJOBIY:  fantastic, fun, delicious,
           interesting, exciting
  SALBIY:  disgusting, horrible, boring

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting' —
  asosan OVQAT haqida.


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a museum   = muzey
  a zoo      = hayvonot bog'i
  a cake     = tort, pirog
  Italian food = italyan taomi
  basketball = basketbol
  fun        = qiziq, zavqli
  interesting = qiziqarli
  exciting   = hayajonli
  boring     = zerikarli

points.en: I've never been to London, but I've been to Paris. I went to Paris a year ago. It was fantastic.
points.uz: Londonda hech qachon bo'lmaganman, lekin Parijda bo'lganman. Parijga bir yil oldin borgandim. Ajoyib edi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.

UCH GAP: tajriba (Present Perfect) →
qachon (Past Simple) → baho (Past Simple).

⚠ 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS!

points.en: I've never visited the museum, but I've visited the zoo. I visited the zoo last month. It was interesting.
points.uz: Muzeyga hech qachon bormaganman, lekin hayvonot bog'iga borganman. U yerga o'tgan oyda bordim. Qiziqarli edi.
points.noteUz:
visit → visited → VISITED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'last month' → Past Simple.

points.en: I've never eaten Chinese food, but I've eaten Italian food. I ate Italian food last week. It was delicious.
points.uz: Xitoy taomini hech qachon yeb ko'rmaganman, lekin italyan taomini yeganman. O'tgan hafta yeganman. Juda mazali edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ V3 va V2 FARQI:
  'I've EATEN' (V3)
  'I ATE it last week' (V2)

'delicious' — ovqat uchun eng mos sifat.

points.en: I've never made a cake, but I've made a pizza. I made a pizza yesterday. It was disgusting!
points.uz: Hech qachon tort pishirmaganman, lekin pitsa tayyorlaganman. Kecha pitsa qildim. Jirkanch edi!
points.noteUz:
make → made → MADE (V2 = V3).
'disgusting' — salbiy baho (ovqat uchun).

points.en: I've never played basketball, but I've played football. I played football on Sunday. It was fun.
points.uz: Hech qachon basketbol o'ynamaganman, lekin futbol o'ynaganman. Yakshanba kuni o'ynadim. Qiziq edi.
points.noteUz:
play → played → PLAYED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'PLAY football/basketball' — sport o'yinlari
artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogues and fill in the gaps with the adjectives from the list. Which dialogue includes positive comments? Which dialogue includes negative comments?
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi sifatlar bilan to'ldiring. Qaysi dialogda ijobiy fikrlar bor? Qaysi dialogda salbiy fikrlar bor?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta sifat):
  horrible, excellent, fantastic, worst,
  disgusting, best, expensive, delicious


⚠ RO'YXAT IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  IJOBIY (4 ta):
     excellent, fantastic, best, delicious

  SALBIY (4 ta):
     horrible, worst, disgusting, expensive

  Va DIALOGLAR ham ikkita:
     1-dialog — IJOBIY fikrlar
     2-dialog — SALBIY fikrlar

  Ya'ni har guruh o'z dialogiga tushadi!


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  FANTASTIC
  2  DELICIOUS
  3  EXCELLENT
  4  BEST
  5  HORRIBLE
  6  DISGUSTING
  7  EXPENSIVE
  8  WORST


1-DIALOG (IJOBIY) — TO'LIQ:

  A: How was your evening last night, Sue?
  B: Oh, wonderful! We went to a FANTASTIC
     restaurant for dinner.
  A: What was it like?
  B: Well, the food was DELICIOUS and the
     service was EXCELLENT. It's definitely
     the BEST restaurant I've ever been to!

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Kecha kechqurunning qanday o'tdi, Syu?
  B: Ajoyib! Kechki ovqatga zo'r restoranga
     bordik.
  A: U qanday edi?
  B: Ovqat juda mazali, xizmat esa a'lo edi.
     Bu, shubhasiz, men borgan eng yaxshi
     restoran!


2-DIALOG (SALBIY) — TO'LIQ:

  A: Did you have a good time last night?
  B: No, not at all. The restaurant was
     HORRIBLE.
  A: Oh, really. Why?
  B: The food was DISGUSTING and it was very
     EXPENSIVE. It's certainly the WORST
     restaurant I've ever been to!

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Kecha kechqurun yaxshi vaqt o'tkazdingmi?
  B: Yo'q, umuman. Restoran dahshatli edi.
  A: Rostdanmi? Nega?
  B: Ovqat jirkanch edi va juda qimmat edi.
     Bu, albatta, men borgan eng yomon
     restoran!


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR BAND:

 1  'We went to a ... restaurant'
    B 'Oh, WONDERFUL!' deb boshlagan →
    IJOBIY sifat kerak.
    'a ... restaurant' — restoran haqida
    umumiy baho → FANTASTIC.

 2  'the food was ...'
    OVQAT haqida ijobiy → DELICIOUS.
    (ovqat uchun eng mos so'z)

 3  'the service was ...'
    XIZMAT haqida ijobiy → EXCELLENT.
    ('delicious' xizmatga mos kelmaydi!)

 4  'the ... restaurant I've ever been to'
    USTUN DARAJA qurilmasi, ijobiy → BEST.

 5  'The restaurant was ...'
    B 'No, NOT AT ALL' deb boshlagan →
    SALBIY sifat kerak → HORRIBLE.

 6  'The food was ...'
    OVQAT haqida salbiy → DISGUSTING.

 7  'and it was very ...'
    Restoran haqida yana bir salbiy fikr →
    EXPENSIVE (qimmat).

 8  'the ... restaurant I've ever been to'
    USTUN DARAJA, salbiy → WORST.


⚠ ENG NOZIK JOY — 2 va 3-BANDLAR:

  'the FOOD was ...'    →  DELICIOUS
  'the SERVICE was ...' →  EXCELLENT

  Nega almashtirib bo'lmaydi?
     'delicious' — FAQAT ovqat haqida
       ('delicious service' XATO)
     'excellent' — har narsa haqida
       ('excellent food' ham to'g'ri)

  Shuning uchun 'delicious' OVQATGA,
  'excellent' esa XIZMATGA tushadi.

  Xuddi shunday 2-dialogda:
     'the FOOD was DISGUSTING' (ovqat)
     'it was very EXPENSIVE' (narx)


⚠ 4 va 8-BANDLAR — USTUN DARAJA:

  'the BEST restaurant I've EVER been to'
  'the WORST restaurant I've EVER been to'

  good → better → THE BEST
  bad  → worse  → THE WORST

  NOTO'G'RI daraja shakllari — YODLANADI.

  Bu qurilma butun unitda BESh marta
  uchraydi (CB 106, GB 66, GB 67, WB 61,
  WB 62).


SAVOLGA JAVOB:
  'Which dialogue includes POSITIVE comments?'
     → 1-DIALOG
  'Which dialogue includes NEGATIVE comments?'
     → 2-DIALOG


DIQQAT — 'DEFINITELY' va 'CERTAINLY':
  1-dialogda: 'It's DEFINITELY the best ...'
  2-dialogda: 'It's CERTAINLY the worst ...'

  Ikkalasi ham 'shubhasiz, albatta' —
  fikrni KUCHAYTIRADI.


DIQQAT — 'NOT AT ALL':
  'No, NOT AT ALL.' = yo'q, umuman
  Rad etishni kuchaytiradi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  excellent  = a'lo
  the service = xizmat
  definitely = shubhasiz
  certainly  = albatta
  not at all = umuman
  expensive  = qimmat
  the best   = eng yaxshi
  the worst  = eng yomon
  a comment  = fikr, izoh

items.sentence: 1  B: Oh, wonderful! We went to a 1) ........................ restaurant for dinner.
items.uz: Ajoyib! Kechki ovqatga zo'r restoranga bordik.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: B 'Oh, WONDERFUL!' deb boshlagan →
IJOBIY sifat kerak.

'a ... restaurant' — restoran haqida umumiy
baho → FANTASTIC.

1-dialog IJOBIY, 2-dialog SALBIY —
ro'yxatdagi 8 sifat teng ikkiga bo'linadi.

⚠ ENG NOZIK JOY: 'the FOOD was ...'

'DELICIOUS' — FAQAT ovqat haqida ishlatiladi.
('delicious service' — XATO)

Shuning uchun 'delicious' OVQATGA tushadi,
'excellent' esa XIZMATGA (3-band).

'the SERVICE was ...' — xizmat haqida.

'EXCELLENT' — har narsa haqida ishlatiladi
(ovqat, xizmat, ish, natija).

'delicious service' — XATO, shuning uchun
bu yerga 'excellent' tushadi.

'the service' = xizmat (restoranda).

items.sentence: 4  It's definitely the 4) ................. restaurant I've ever been to!
items.uz: Bu, shubhasiz, men borgan eng yaxshi restoran!

commonMistake.whyUz:
USTUN DARAJA qurilmasi:
'the ... restaurant I've EVER been to'

1-dialog IJOBIY → BEST.

good → better → THE BEST (noto'g'ri daraja).

'definitely' = shubhasiz (kuchaytiruvchi).

items.sentence: 5  B: No, not at all. The restaurant was 5) .............. .

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: B 'No, NOT AT ALL' deb boshlagan →
SALBIY sifat kerak.

'The restaurant was ...' — restoran haqida
umumiy salbiy baho → HORRIBLE.

'not at all' = umuman (rad etishni
kuchaytiradi).

'the FOOD was ...' — ovqat haqida SALBIY.

'DISGUSTING' — asosan ovqat haqida
ishlatiladi ('delicious' ning ziddi).

Coursebook 105-bet, 6-mashq:
delicious ↔ disgusting.

'it was very ...' — restoran haqida yana bir
salbiy fikr.

Qolgan salbiy sifatlar: expensive, worst.
'worst' USTUN DARAJA (8-band uchun),
shuning uchun bu yerga EXPENSIVE.

DIQQAT: 'very expensive' ✓ /
'very worst' — g'alati.

items.sentence: 8  It's certainly the 8) ....................... restaurant I've ever been to!
items.uz: Bu, albatta, men borgan eng yomon restoran!

commonMistake.whyUz:
USTUN DARAJA qurilmasi, 2-dialog SALBIY
→ WORST.

bad → worse → THE WORST (noto'g'ri daraja).

⚠ 4-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  4  'the BEST restaurant I've ever been to'
  8  'the WORST restaurant I've ever been to'

'certainly' = albatta (kuchaytiruvchi).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the dialogue below into the correct order. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues. — Making a Reservation
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni to'g'ri tartibga soling. So'ngra juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing. — Joy band qilish
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  A: Sunset Hotel. Can I help you?
  2  B: Yes, I'd like to book a room from the
        16th to the 21st of May, please.
  3  A: Of course, sir. Would you like a
        single room or a double room?
  4  B: A single room, please.
  5  A: Certainly. Could I have your name,
        please?
  6  B: Adams. Peter Adams.
  7  A: Thank you, Mr Adams. We'll see you on
        the 16th, then.


KITOBDAGI TARTIB (yuqoridan pastga) va
TO'G'RI RAQAMI:

  'Certainly. Could I have your name?'    → 5
  'Yes, I'd like to book a room ...'      → 2
  'Sunset Hotel. Can I help you?'         → 1
  'Adams. Peter Adams.'                   → 6
  'Of course, sir. Would you like a
   single room or a double room?'         → 3
  'Thank you, Mr Adams. We'll see you
   on the 16th, then.'                    → 7
  'A single room, please.'                → 4


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  1  A: Sunset mehmonxonasi. Yordam bera
        olamanmi?
  2  B: Ha, 16-maydan 21-mayigacha xona band
        qilmoqchi edim.
  3  A: Albatta, janob. Bir kishilik xona
        xohlaysizmi yoki ikki kishilik?
  4  B: Bir kishilik xona, iltimos.
  5  A: Yaxshi. Ismingizni ayta olasizmi?
  6  B: Adams. Piter Adams.
  7  A: Rahmat, mister Adams. Unda 16-sanada
        ko'rishguncha.


⚠ QANDAY ANIQLANADI — UCh BELGI:

  A) BIRINCHI GAP — kim boshlaydi?
     'Sunset Hotel. Can I help you?'
     Telefon ko'targan odam DOIM shunday
     boshlaydi (joy nomi + yordam taklifi).
     → 1-o'rin

  B) SAVOL-JAVOB JUFTLIKLARI:
     'Would you like a single or a double
      room?'  →  'A single room, please.'
     'Could I have your name?'
              →  'Adams. Peter Adams.'

     Har savoldan KEYIN javob keladi.

  C) OXIRGI GAP — xayrlashish:
     'Thank you, Mr Adams. We'll see you on
      the 16th, then.'
     'Mr ADAMS' — ismni bilgandan KEYIN
     aytiladi, demak 6-banddan keyin.
     → 7-o'rin


⚠ ENG MUHIM MANTIQIY ZANJIR:

  Ism 6-bandda aytiladi ('Peter Adams'),
  va 7-bandda ishlatiladi ('Mr ADAMS').

  Demak 6 → 7 tartibi ANIQ.

  Shu kabi:
     3 ('single or double?') → 4 ('a single')
     5 ('your name?')        → 6 ('Adams')


JOY BAND QILISh — FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  MEHMONXONA (A):
     '[Nomi] Hotel. Can I help you?'
     'Would you like a single room or a
      double room?'
     'Could I have your name, please?'
     'We'll see you on the [sana], then.'

  MIJOZ (B):
     'I'd like to book a room from the ...
      to the ...'
     'A single/double room, please.'
     '[Familiya]. [Ism] [Familiya].'


XONA TURLARI:
  a single room  = bir kishilik xona
  a double room  = ikki kishilik xona
                   (bitta katta karavot)
  a twin room    = ikki kishilik xona
                   (ikki karavot)


DIQQAT — SANALARNI AYTISh:
  'from the 16th TO the 21st of May'
  = 16-maydan 21-mayigacha

  Tartib sonlar:
     1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ... 16th, 21st

  'the 16th' o'qilishi: 'the sixteenth'.


DIQQAT — 'COULD I HAVE ...?':
  'COULD I have your name, please?'
  'could' — 'can' dan ODOBLIROQ.

  Coursebook 108-bet, 3-dialogda ham shu
  ibora bor edi.


DIQQAT — 'CERTAINLY' va 'OF COURSE':
  Ikkalasi ham 'albatta' — xizmat sohasida
  odobli javob.

  'sir' — erkakka; 'madam' — ayolga.


COURSEBOOK 108-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda RESTORANDA stol band qilish bor edi:
     'I'd like to book a table for tonight.'
     'What time and for how many?'
     'Could I have your name, please?'

  Bu yerda esa MEHMONXONADA xona band qilish.
  Tuzilishi bir xil!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a reservation = joy band qilish
  to book a room = xona band qilmoq
  a single room = bir kishilik xona
  a double room = ikki kishilik xona
  Certainly     = Albatta
  sir / madam   = janob / xonim
  from ... to ... = ... dan ... gacha

Aniqlashtiruvchi savol.
'Would you like ...?' — odobli taklif.
'sir' — erkakka murojaat.

3-savolga JAVOB.

a single room = bir kishilik;
a double room = ikki kishilik (bitta katta
karavot).

points.noteUz:

Coursebook 108-betda ham shu ibora bor edi.

5-savolga JAVOB.

DIQQAT: avval FAMILIYA, keyin to'liq ism —

points.en: 7  A: Thank you, Mr Adams. We'll see you on the 16th, then.
points.uz: 7  A: Rahmat, mister Adams. Unda 16-sanada ko'rishguncha.

⚠ OXIRGI gap: 'Mr ADAMS' — ismni BILGANDAN

Bu — tartibni aniqlashning eng ishonchli
belgisi.

patterns.formula: I'VE NEVER + [V3] ..., BUT I'VE + [V3] ... .  I + [V2] ... [ANIQ VAQT].  It WAS + [sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: I've never been to London, but I've been to Paris. I went to Paris a year ago. It was fantastic.
patterns.exampleUz: Londonda bo'lmaganman, lekin Parijda bo'lganman. Bir yil oldin bordim. Ajoyib edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
UCH GAP: tajriba (Present Perfect) →
qachon (Past Simple) → baho (Past Simple).

patterns.formula: It's DEFINITELY / CERTAINLY the BEST / WORST + [ot] + I'VE EVER + [V3].
patterns.exampleEn: It's definitely the best restaurant I've ever been to! It's certainly the worst restaurant I've ever been to!
patterns.exampleUz: Bu, shubhasiz, men borgan eng yaxshi restoran! Bu, albatta, men borgan eng yomon restoran!
patterns.explanationUz:
USTUN DARAJA + 'I've EVER + V3'.
good → the BEST;  bad → the WORST.
'definitely'/'certainly' — kuchaytiruvchi.

patterns.exampleEn: He was born on 6th May, 1959. When were you born?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to be born' — 'be' fe'li SHART.
'He born' — XATO.

patterns.formula: I'D LIKE TO BOOK A ROOM FROM THE ... TO THE ... .
patterns.exampleEn: I'd like to book a room from the 16th to the 21st of May, please.
patterns.explanationUz:
Mehmonxonada joy band qilish shakli.
'from ... to ...' — sana oralig'i.
